name: states-lowering
description: The .states(@state.path) { onState(label)... } applicator resolves the matching pose on initial render: pose props override base values as plain JSON, the engine synthesizes __anim.transition from the header timing scoped to the animatable overridden keys (in pose-declaration order), and __anim.states carries the active label. No states.0/onState.0 junk props, no engine-internal StateSwitch novelty on the wire
